input_fields.name: feature_positions
input_fields.description: Resolved positions/axes of one repeated feature set in one coordinate frame.

input_fields.name: expected_repeat_rule
input_fields.description: One spacing, angular, pitch, or bolt-circle rule to check.

input_fields.name: tolerance
input_fields.description: Nonnegative comparison tolerance in the rule's units.

result_fields.name: placement_result
result_fields.description: Observed pairwise/rule deviations, frame, and feature identities.

procedure: Resolve the supplied feature positions in one frame and validate one expected_repeat_rule.
Compute the rule-specific spacing/angle/pitch deviations against tolerance.
Return placement_result and comparison_status with each feature identity.
Do not search for or create additional repeated instances in this atom.
rejection_rules: Reject mixed frames, duplicate/ambiguous feature identities, negative tolerance, or multiple rules.
Reject a visual count as proof of placement.
Do not repair placement or reorder features.
